en: {player}! I got every Badge too, just like you. I came all this way to tell you something.
I'm not the boy who couldn't even catch a Pokémon any more. I've trained hard with my partners.
So this time I won't lose. Not to anyone, not even to you!
I lost again... But it doesn't feel the same as the first time. I gave it everything I had.
You go on ahead, {player}. I'm going to rest here a little, and then I'll follow you to the League!
You go on ahead, {player}. I'll follow you to the League once I've rested!
{player}! I heard you became the Champion. Congratulations! I knew you would.
I've been training here ever since, so I could battle the Champion. Will you show me what that's like?
Wow... So that's the strength of a Champion. I've still got a long way to go.
I'll keep training on Victory Road. One day I'll catch up with you, {player}. Just you wait!
